Hand-pinned, additive section - existing Canon vectors untouched (git diff proves it; Canon totals ride unchanged). The law: sessionKey fnv (0-guard) -> per-round fmix64 quota draw k in [1..ceil(n/2)] over ALL groups (ranking by fmix64(fnv('dutyrank|id|rN')^seed), Ordinal tiebreak), candidates = the modifizierte Muster (dutyModifiers row sum > 0 rides; key absent = degraded: base weights + quota ranking - the SHIPPED-asset path), over-cap demotion by the ranking, §9.2 floor k>=1 whenever a duty + a mobile group exists, immobile (printed Stativ/Tripod) groups never escort. The escort/combat vectors read the REAL HOTH10 duty fact through the P37b reader (anchor 'Cell', the non-walkable Highlight stays valid - no Board check). Patterns are pinned INPUT facts (the pattern dice itself is Canon-pinned elsewhere - the duty layer only READS them, G1). Shadow cases Prime synthetic PatternWeight docs and RESTORE the shipped asset afterwards (same discipline as duty_loader's modifier_cases).
